newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil March coffee exports 1.39 mln bags - Abecafe.
newsitem.headline: Brazil March coffee exports 1.39 mln bags - Abecafe.

text.p: Brazilian coffee exports in March totalled 1.39 million 60-kg bags against 514,606 bags in the same month last year, said the Brazilian Coffee Exporters' Association (Abecafe).
The March total is based on figures from the Industry and Commerce Ministry, Abecafe said in a statement.
In the first three months of this year, shipments reached 3.89 million bags, 124 percent up on the 1.74 million bags exported in January to March 1996.
Abecafe estimates that shipments in 1997 will reach 16.1 percent, representing a 24 percent rise on 1996.
The Brazilian Coffee Exporters Federation (Febec) normally only issues its export figures after the 10th of the month.
According to today's Rio de Janeiro Coffee Business Center bulletin, bills of lading for March shipments received by April 7 covered 1.44 million bags.
